provenance.ingestion_method: User-pasted AK2 betting frequencies in the standard-Xeno collection. Exact suits, bet size, and game setup carried over from collection context.

inherited_fields: Exact suits: As Kh 2h (collection suit pattern)
Table size, starting stacks, antes and rake
Complete action menu: check or bet 75% pot

range_weights.source_note: User-supplied standard-Xeno AK2 node range weights, matched to the betting export by unordered physical card pair.

game.pot_accounting_note: Flop pot and ante structure are user-reported; blind/straddle amounts and rake timing have not been independently reconstructed.

action.nominal_size_note: Derived as 17.5 × 0.75; actual solver rounding is unspecified.

data_semantics.combo_card_order: Preserved exactly as pasted; each unordered two-card holding occurs once.
data_semantics.blocked_entries: Retained from the export; flagged and excluded from legal-combo analysis.
data_semantics.zero_entries: A zero for a legal combo that reaches this node means always check. A zero alone does not establish range membership; absent-range and board-blocked combos must not be assigned checking weight.
data_semantics.aggregate_formula: sum(reach_weight[c] * frequency[c]) / sum(reach_weight[c]), over legal combos at this decision.
data_semantics.combination_suit_averaging: None; exact suit-specific frequencies are retained.
data_semantics.check_frequency_rule: For a legal combo with positive reach weight at this decision, check_frequency = 1 - frequency, under the collection check-or-bet-75%-only menu. Exclude blocked and zero-reach-weight combos.
data_semantics.action_menu_source: Carried over from the shared collection setup: BTN checks or bets 75% pot only.
data_semantics.range_weight_scale: 0 to 1 per exact physical two-card combination; not normalized to sum to one. Do not multiply by suited/offsuit/pair combo counts again.

unconfirmed_context: Flop action history before BTN decision
Blind and straddle sizes; rake application timing

derived_statistics.calculation: Sum over legal combinations: bet weight = reach_weight * frequency; check weight = reach_weight * (1 - frequency).
derived_statistics.precision: Decimal arithmetic on the pasted decimal values; JSON summaries may be rounded at serialization.
